title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre - Stanford University on 1982-10-10

ai_review.summary: A legendary audience (AUD) tape with crystal‑clear sound that captures a high‑energy 1982 Frost show featuring a smoking Crazy Fingers and unforgettable Lost Sailor/​Saint of Circumstance.
ai_review.review: This recording is repeatedly called the best AUD on the Archive – the mics were positioned right by the monitors, giving guitar, bass and drums an almost soundboard presence with no noticeable hiss or drop‑outs. The performance itself is described as high‑energy and transcendent, highlighted by a monster Crazy Fingers, a soaring Lost Sailor/Saint of Circumstance, tight China>Rider and many inspired moments from the band. Reviewers rave about Jerry’s guitar tone, Phil’s thunderous bass and Bob’s vivid vocal improvisations, making this one of the standout 1982 shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Uniform 4‑5 star reviews (15 total) praise both the exceptional audience recording quality and a high‑energy, musically superb performance; the large volume of detailed comments yields a very confident rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mics placed near monitors give a "mouth" tape sound; crystal‑clear guitar and bass, virtually soundboard‑like, no hiss or dropouts noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, seamless flow with high‑energy transitions; pre‑drums selections and the second set build a trance‑like momentum that sustains throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar tone described as stunning and “crunchy”; notable midi‑guitar solo and slide work on Red Rooster praised.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass response called "insane", especially during the Drums segment; overall powerful low end noted.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocal improvisations highlighted (rain improv in Looks Like Rain, witty crowd interaction), adding emotional depth.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums section praised for its presence and energy; bass response during this part emphasized as a highlight.
